senses.gloss: f. (cmp. שָׁקוּט) flamingo (from its abruptly bent beak).—Pl. שְׁקִיטְנָאֵי, שִׁיקְטְ׳.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 63a:2">Ḥull. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ אריכי שקי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (Ms. R. 1 <he>שִׁקְטְנָאֵי</he>; ed. sing., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) flamingos, those with long legs and red are permitted, the short-legged and red are forbidden.
